name: RMAN 增量备份策略配置诊断
description: RMAN 增量备份分为 Level 0（全备基础）和 Level 1（变更块）。Level 1 又分 Differential（自上次 Level 1）和 Cumulative（自上次 Level 0）。选择直接影响备份窗口和恢复时间。

skip_when.desc: 数据库 < 50GB 全备足够快

root_causes.name: 仅使用全备
root_causes.desc: 大库全备耗时长。应用 Level 0 + Level 1 组合。

root_causes.name: Differential vs Cumulative 选择不当
root_causes.desc: Differential 恢复慢（多个增量），Cumulative 每日渐增但恢复快。

root_causes.name: BCT 未启用
root_causes.desc: 无 BCT 增量扫描接近全备。

root_causes.name: Level 0 过期
root_causes.desc: Level 0 太老，恢复 apply 时间长。

oltp.desc: 每日 Cumulative Level 1，每周 Level 0

step1_check_incremental_history.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_backups, SUM(CASE WHEN input_type = 'DB FULL' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS full_only_count, SUM(CASE WHEN input_type LIKE 'DB INCR%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS incr_count, MAX(ROUND(elapsed_seconds/60, 1)) AS max_elapsed_min FROM v$rman_backup_job_details WHERE start_time > SYSDATE - 14 AND status = 'COMPLETED'

step2_check_level0_age.desc: 最近 Level 0 基础备份距今天数
step2_check_level0_age.sql: SELECT MAX(completion_time) AS last_level0, ROUND(SYSDATE - MAX(completion_time), 1) AS days_since_level0 FROM v$backup_datafile WHERE incremental_level = 0

step3_check_bct_status.sql: SELECT status AS bct_status, filename AS bct_file FROM v$block_change_tracking

step4_check_change_rate.sql: SELECT TRUNC(completion_time) AS day, ROUND(SUM(blocks_read * block_size)/1024/1024/1024, 2) AS changed_gb FROM v$backup_datafile WHERE incremental_level = 1 AND completion_time > SYSDATE - 7 GROUP BY TRUNC(completion_time) ORDER BY day DESC

branches.label: 仅使用全备，无增量备份
branches.confidence: 置信度 90%: incr_count = 0 确认无增量备份
findings: 近14天所有备份均为全备，无增量备份策略
大库全备耗时长，应配置 Level 0 + Level 1 组合

actions.desc: 配置增量备份策略：每周 Level 0，每日 Cumulative Level 1
actions.risk: 首次 Level 0 需要全备时间窗口

branches.label: 有增量备份，检查 BCT 和 Level 0 时效

then.step: Step 2: 检查 BCT 状态

branches.label: BCT 未启用 — 增量扫描接近全备
findings: Block Change Tracking 未启用，增量备份需全库扫描
无 BCT 时增量备份耗时接近全备

actions.sql: ALTER DATABASE ENABLE BLOCK CHANGE TRACKING USING FILE '/u01/app/oracle/bct/bct.chg';
actions.rollback: ALTER DATABASE DISABLE BLOCK CHANGE TRACKING;

branches.label: BCT 已启用，检查 Level 0 时效
